CustomField.description: Rich text stored for the template footer region. Use the dedicated footer Form component (FormQualifiedApiName (Footer)) for the rendered runtime footer; this field holds simple HTML footer content where a full Form component is not configured.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Add formatted footer content (disclaimers, contact info, links) to show at the bottom of the form. For richer footers, configure a footer Form component instead.
CustomField.label: Template Footer Text
